correctness.rationale: The finite count-process generator is explicitly derived and proven to have a unique recurrent class. Exact first and second generator equations give mean and variance, with boundary pair multiplicities handled. The limiting generator follows by uniform Taylor control and stationary part-consensus, giving a uniquely moment-determined Beta weak limit. Standalone exact solver passed for 16 nontrivial finite pairs; symbolic algebra verifies all finite moment equations and twelve limiting moments.

value.rationale: A natural two-source social influence model exhibits exact finite fluctuations and an explicit full stationary limiting distribution for every positive limiting bipartition ratio. The result isolates persistent macroscopic fluctuations, skew from zealot degree/position and the balanced-uniform special case; it is not a routine graph parameter substitution, and does not claim irrelevant broader universality.
